# Synthetic Dataset Dictionary

**File generated by:** analyze.py  
**Default observations:** 500  
**Default random seed:** 20261120  
**Status:** Synthetic teaching data only; not measured household or utility data.

| Variable | Type | Unit / coding | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| annual_kwh | Continuous | kWh/year | Simulated annual household electricity consumption |
| floor_area_sqft | Continuous | square feet | Simulated conditioned floor area |
| income_1000s_usd | Continuous | USD thousands/year | Simulated household income, expressed in thousands of dollars |
| heating_degree_days | Continuous | degree-days | Simulated annual heating degree days |
| electric_heat | Binary | 0/1 | Simulated indicator for electric space heating |

## Data-generating process

The script sets a fixed NumPy random seed. Income is drawn from a lognormal distribution and clipped to a specified range. Floor area is positively related to income plus random variation. Heating degree days are generated independently. Electric heating is a Bernoulli indicator. Consumption is generated as a linear function plus heteroskedastic noise whose scale increases with income.

The data-generating process is intentionally visible to support testing and interpretation. Because the data are simulated from a known structure, fitted coefficients are not evidence about real households. The exercise demonstrates estimation, robust inference, confounding, and reproducibility only.

## Data handling

Regenerate with:

    python analyze.py --n 500 --seed 20261120 --output results

Record any change to the seed, sample size, or data-generating process. Never hand-edit the generated CSV and then claim it is a reproducible model output.
